messages:
Emma: :loud_sound: Heads up — planned control-plane drain and SLO policy update for eu-west-1 this Thursday 03:00–04:30 UTC. Intended to rotate k8s masters + apply control-plane hotfix. Impact: short control-plane API spikes and increased kube-apiserver latency for ~5–10m during each master restart.
Lee: ETA? will this affect customer traffic or only internal control-plane ops?
Emma: Main customer-facing dataplane (inference) will continue serving. We expect some API call timeouts for management APIs (deploys, scaling, config reads). No token generation or inference traffic should be dropped.
Jyoti: We will also run a quick autoscaler ramp test after the drain to validate HPA scaling velocity — low risk but want SRE coverage.
Sam: Related note — we're rolling out the new SLO burn-rate policy: background maintenance windows (like this) will allow a temporary +30% SLO burn tolerance for 1 hour to avoid noisy alerts. After 1h, normal burn thresholds apply.
Lee: Can we get the exact runbook and rollback steps in this thread? I want it pinned for oncall.
Emma: Pinned runbook below. TL;DR: drain masters sequentially, wait for leader election, monitor apiserver error rate, run autoscaler smoke test, then validate k8s events. If anything looks off, rollback by aborting the next master restart and re-inserting the node.
Emma: Runbook excerpt:
```
# control-plane-maint-runbook
1) Notify oncall + infra channel
2) For master in masters-eu-west1: kubectl cordon master && ssh master -- sudo systemctl restart kube-apiserver
3) wait 120s, check /metrics and apiserver logs
4) if errors > 5% for > 3m -> run rollback: ssh master -- sudo systemctl start previous-apiserver.service; abort further restarts
5) post maintenance: run autoscaler smoke test: kubectl apply -f hpa-stress.yaml
```
Lee: Who's driving the restart? I can be primary oncall for the first two restarts.
Jyoti: I'll be on infra to run the commands and watch leader election. Sam will run the autoscaler test.
Sam: autoscaler test steps: apply hpa-stress, then `kubectl get hpa -w` and ensure metrics server reports CPU spike, expected scale up within 90s for replicas > 1. We'll revert hpa-stress after verification.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: control-plane-hotfix v2.14 at 2025-11-06T03:05:00Z (triggered by infra).
pagerduty-bot: PD alert policy temporarily suppressed for maintenance window 2025-11-06T03:00:00Z -> 2025-11-06T04:00:00Z (SLO-burn policy: +30% tolerance).
Emma: Observability links: Grafana apiserver dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/apiserver?orgId=1, Logs query: https://logs.redwood.internal/q?query=apiserver+error%3A
Lee: Any preflight checks we should run before 03:00?
Jyoti: Yes — 30m prior run `kubectl get componentstatuses` and `kubectl get cs -o wide`, validate etcd health, and ensure backups completed in last 6h. I'll trigger backup at T-2h.
Emma: Preflight checklist (short):
- etcd ok (healthy)
- backups recent (<6h)
- no active cluster upgrades in last 2h
- oncall + infra slack pings are green
- smoke test manifest validated (hpa-stress.yaml)
Lee: If we see >10% 5xx from control-plane during a restart, do we immediately rollback?
Emma: If >10% 5xx sustained for >5m and critical ops failing (rollouts, scale), abort next restart and re-run previous apiserver binary. Otherwise continue but escalate to oncall lead.
Sam: After completion, we'll run a quick synthetic job that calls control-plane endpoints 100x and verify p95 latency < 200ms for management APIs.
Lee: I'll be monitoring incident slack and PD channel. I'll also annotate the runbook with timing markers as we go.
Jyoti: Noted — infra will open a temporary incident channel in #incidents/maintenance-eu-west1 and post status updates every 10m.
Emma: Post-maintenance actions: collect APIServer metrics snapshot, export leader election logs, and file a short blameless postmortem if any unexpected regression.
Lee: Acknowledged.
Emma: Thanks team. If you can't make the window, shout now so we can reschedule. Otherwise treat this as the official maintenance notice. :white_check_mark:
